decisions.canonicalPackFormat: 16-card wax format with channel abstractions pending
decisions.physicalWaxFormat: 16 cards; 36 packs/box. No Magic Motion inserts in 1992.
decisions.hotRookiesConversion: One per 100-base-card blister. 100/16=6.25 wax equivalents rounded to 1:6 VCS packs. Derived channel approximation, not historical wax odds.
decisions.impactPlayers: 90 total: 1-45 Series One and 46-90 Series Two. Five per 45-card Superpack. VCS can pull only one card per insert family per pack, so odds remain null pending a deliberate engine/abstraction decision.
decisions.rareOdds: DiMaggio, DiMaggio autographs, Franchise, Franchise autographs and Knoblauch autograph print runs/distribution verified, but pack odds unverified. oddsPerPack=null prevents invented pull rates. All remain unavailable in packs until Admin odds are set.
decisions.oddsReview: PENDING; release blocked until all intended insert availability is configured.
decisions.variations: 48 extra error/print rows collapse to 893 canonical base cards. Prefer explicit Pack version when source distinguishes factory states; otherwise corrected/later b state.
decisions.exclusions: Factory Bonus Cards, promos, promo panels, Rookie/Traded, Pinnacle and other separate products excluded.
decisions.autographs: Five DiMaggio subjects share an aggregate SN2500 series, with five cards reserved for sweepstakes. Knoblauch is a gold-ink signed 1990 Score #672 SN3000, with 11 cards reserved. Franchise #1-3 SN2000 blue ink and #4 triple SN500 gold ink remain one complete four-card checklist.
